title: Mobile App Architecture in Kotlin: ViewModel, StateFlow, Paging and Testable Logic
concept: Structure the Rice Rocket courier app on Android so features stay easy to change: unidirectional data flow with ViewModel and StateFlow, screen state machines, one-off events, repositories with cache policies (Room), Paging-style cursors, optimistic updates, dependency inversion, view model tests with a fake clock, and feature flags. Challenges are Kotlin programs (with kotlinx.coroutines) graded in the code runner.
description: Structure the Rice Rocket courier app on Android so features stay easy to change: unidirectional data flow with ViewModel and StateFlow, screen state machines, one-off events, repositories with cache policies (Room), Paging-style cursors, optimistic updates, dependency inversion, view model tests with a fake clock, and feature flags. 9 lessons on one project, each applying the tool to a real production situation, with 1-2 graded challenges per lesson.

learningOutcomes.text: Model screens as state with reducers and state machines driven by unidirectional data flow.
Deliver one-off events without losing or repeating them.
Serve data through repositories with cache policies, cursor paging and optimistic updates.
Invert dependencies for fast tests and release features behind flags.
